effects.description: (3 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(5 items) Adds 6-258 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) When you kill an enemy, you fill an empty Soul Gem and heal for 5906 Health.

The heal can occur once every |cffffff10|r seconds and scales off the higher of your Max Magicka or Stamina.
